trials.title: Safety and Efficacy of Adjunct Therapies in Adults With Type 1 Diabetes: Multicenter, Registry Study
trials.summary: This will be a multicenter registry-based study to evaluate safety and efficacy of GLP-1RA and SGLTi therapies in adjunct to insulin in adults with type 1 diabetes (T1D) over 1 year. This study will enroll participants who have been prescribed adjunct therapy as part of usual care.

trials.title: A Research Study Investigating How Adults With Overweight or Obesity, With or Without Type 2 Diabetes, Tolerate Switching to a New Treatment (Zenagamtide) From Their Current Semaglutide Medication
trials.summary: The purpose of this clinical study is to find out which zenagamtide dose can be switched to, from maintenance dose of semaglutide in people with overweight or obesity, with or without type 2 diabetes (T2D). All participants will get semaglutide and zenagamtide.

trials.title: NEPC Study: An Exploratory Safety and Efficacy Study With PSMA, SSTR2 and GRPR Targeted Radioligand Therapy in Metastatic Neuroendocrine Prostate Cancer.
trials.summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the change in the expression of treatment targets on the surface of tumor cells (Prostate Specific Membrane Antigen (PSMA), Somatostatin Receptor 2 (SSTR2), and Gastrin Releasing Peptide Receptor (GRPR) between the baseline and following targeted radioligand therapy (RLT). trials.title: A Study to Learn About Switching to a Monthly Study Medicine Called Berobenatide (PF-08653944) to Help Keep Weight Off in People With Overweight or Obesity
trials.summary:
The purpose of this study is to learn about the safety and effectiveness of berobenatide in adults with overweight or obesity who have already lost weight while taking semaglutide or tirzepatide. The study does not include people with diabetes.

Participants will be in the study for about 11 months.

trials.title: Therapeutic Strategies for Microvascular Dysfunction in Type 1 Diabetes
trials.summary: The investigators will test the hypothesis that, in adults with type 1 diabetes (T1D), glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonism (GLP-1RA, i.e. dulaglutide) enhances insulin-mediated skeletal muscle microvascular perfusion via attenuating endothelial oxidative stress and thereby improving endothelial function.

trials.title: A Study of BGM0504 in Participants With Type 2 Diabetes
trials.summary: This trial is conducted in China. The aim of the trial is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of BGM0504 versus semaglutide as add-on to metformin and/or sulfonylureas in patients with type 2 diabetes

trials.title: Semaglutide vs Sitagliptin
trials.summary: The effect of once daily dosing of oral Semaglutide versus once daily dosing Sitagliptin on glycemic control, body weight, and safety and tolerability will be compared in Liver Transplant Recipients with poorly-controlled Diabetes Mellitus.

trials.title: Efficacy, Safety, and Pharmacokinetics of Tirzepatide (LY3298176) Once Weekly Versus Placebo in Pediatric Participants 6 to Less Than 12 Years of Age Who Have Obesity (ADVANCE-SURMOUNT-KIDS)
trials.summary:
The main purpose of this study, performed under Master Protocol J4M-MC-PWMP (NCT06672549), is to evaluate the efficacy, safety, and pharmacokinetics of tirzepatide as an addition to healthy lifestyle in participants 6 to less than 12 years of age, with obesity. Participation in the study will last about 104 weeks.

trials.title: A Neuropsychobiological Approach to Optimize Patient Selection for GLP-1-based Pharmacotherapy for Weight Management Across the Binge Eating Spectrum
trials.summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to investigate how GLP-1 receptor analogs, such as semaglutide (Wegovy®), influence processes that determine eating behavior, binge eating, and weight regulation via the gut-brain axis. The main question it aims to answer is: to identify for whom semaglutide works best.

Participants will:

* undergo a semaglutide treatment for 6 months
* visit the clinic for 2-4 study checkup and tests
* wear a smartwatch and complete questionnaires on their smartphone

trials.title: Research Study on Whether Semaglutide Works in People With Non-alcoholic Steatohepatitis (NASH)
trials.summary:
Semaglutide is a medicine studied in patients with NASH. Semaglutide is a well-known medicine, which is already used by doctors to treat type 2 diabetes in many countries.

Participants will either get semaglutide or a dummy medicine - which treatment participants get is decided by chance.

Participants will need to inject themselves with medicine under the skin. Participants will need to do this once a week.

trials.title: A Study of BGM0504 in Participants With Type 2 Diabetes in Indonesia
trials.summary: This trial is conducted in Indonesia. The aim of the trial is to evaluate the efficacy and safety of BGM0504 versus semaglutide as add-on to metformin in patients with type 2 diabetes

trials.title: A Trial of Oral VRB-103 Alone or in Combination With Oral Ecnoglutide (VRB-101) in Participants With Obesity or Overweight
trials.summary: The primary objective is to evaluate the safety and tolerability of VRB-103 tablets administered as monotherapy or VRB-103 tablets administered in combination with oral ecnoglutide tablets (VRB-101 tablets) in a single-dose regimen or in a multiple dose regimen.

trials.title: Tirzepatide s Dopaminergic Effects in Alcohol Use Disorders (AUD)
trials.summary:
Background:

Glucagon-like peptide 1 (GLP-1) agonist drugs are used to treat diabetes and aid weight loss. They may also help reduce cravings for drugs and alcohol. Researchers want to know if a GLP-1 drug (tirzepatide) can lessen the urge to drink in people with alcohol use disorder (AUD).

Objective:

To learn how the brains of people with AUD respond to a GLP-1 drug.

Eligibility:

People aged 21 to 65 years with AUD who are non-treatment seeking. They must be enrolled in protocol 14-AA-0181.

trials.title: A Study to Evaluate ALN-2232 in Participants With Obesity
trials.summary:
The purpose of this study is to:

* evaluate the safety, tolerability, efficacy, pharmacokinetics (PK), and pharmacodynamics (PD) of single ascending doses of ALN-2232 in patients with obesity
* evaluate the safety, tolerability, efficacy, PK, and PD of multiple doses of ALN-2232 in patients with obesity
* evaluate the safety, tolerability, efficacy, PK, and PD of multiple doses of ALN-2232 co-initiated with tirzepatide in patients with obesity

trials.title: CGM Use in Adults With Type 2 Diabetes on Basal Insulin
trials.summary:
A prospective multi-centre, open-label, two arm, parallel design, superiority, pragmatic, randomised controlled trial, over an 8-month period. The purpose of this study is to determine whether continuous glucose monitoring using FreeStyle Libre 3 will improve HbA1c compared to SMBG over 16 weeks in adults with sub-optimally controlled (HbA1c 7.5-11%) Type 2 diabetes on basal therapy.

Following completion of the 8-month period for all participants, an optional non-interventional follow-up period

trials.title: Subcutaneous Tirzepatide Once-weekly in Patients With Obesity and Knee Osteoarthritis (STOP KNEE-OA)
trials.summary: This is a trial of tirzepatide in people with obesity and knee osteoarthritis. The main purpose of this study is to see if tirzepatide can reduce number of these participants who require a knee replacement. Participants will be randomized to take a weekly injection of tirzepatide or a placebo for a total of 72 weeks.

trials.title: Semaglutide for Helping Opioid Recovery
trials.summary: The is a pilot, 12-week, double-blind, placebo-controlled, randomized trial of individuals with opioid use disorder (OUD) newly initiating buprenorphine to receive either weekly injections of semaglutide (n=23) or matching placebo (n=23). The primary aim is to determine the effects of semaglutide on cue-reactivity among individuals with OUD. The secondary aim is to assess the preliminary efficacy, safety, and tolerability of semaglutide for OUD.

trials.title: A Study of BGM0504 in Early T2DM With Obesity
trials.summary: This trial is conducted in China. The aim is to compare BGM0504 Injection 15 mg with semaglutide 1.0 mg in Chinese T2DM patients with obesity and inadequate control despite diet and exercise. Over 52 weeks of once weekly treatment, efficacy and safety are evaluated, including the rate of diabetes remission at 12 weeks after treatment discontinuation.

trials.title: A Study of LY3457263 Compared With Placebo in Participants With Type 2 Diabetes on a Stable Dose of Semaglutide or Tirzepatide
trials.summary: The purpose of this study is to measure the change in hemoglobin A1c (HbA1c) with LY3457263 compared with placebo in participants with type 2 diabetes who are not at HbA1c goal when treated with a stable dose of semaglutide or tirzepatide. Participation in the study will last about 9 months.

trials.title: MODERN-Dental: Pediatric Obesity, Cardiometabolic Risks, And Periodontal Disease
trials.summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to assess whether adjunctive dental cleaning can enhance the effects of semaglutide in children with obesity. The main question\[s\] it aims to answer \[is/are\]:

if dental cleaning will improve both oral health and metabolic outcomes beyond the effects of semaglutide alone.

Participants will receive either dental cleaning and oral hygiene instruction or oral hygiene instruction alone.

trials.title: Trial of Innovative Fat-loss Focused Approaches in Patients With Class I Obesity: a Comparative Study
trials.summary:
This single-center randomized comparative study is designed to compare the effectiveness of tirzepatide and transcutaneous low-frequency auricular vagus nerve stimulation in adults with class I obesity and without chronic non-communicable diseases. The study focuses on changes in body weight, anthropometric indices, epicardial and visceral adipose tissue, body composition, behavioral factors, skeletal muscle characteristics, and cardiac structure and function.

trials.title: A Master Protocol of Multiple Agents in Adults With Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (SYNERGY-Outcomes)
trials.summary: The main purpose of the SYNERGY-OUTCOMES study is to find out whether retatrutide and tirzepatide can prevent major adverse liver outcomes (MALO) in people with high-risk metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). The study will enroll adults who have MASLD based on non-invasive tests (NITs), which indicate they are more likely to develop MALO. Participants will be randomly assigned within a Master Protocol to receive either retatrutide (N1T-MC-RT01), tirzepatide (N1T-MC-T

trials.title: A Study of Orforglipron (LY3502970) in Participants With Type 2 Diabetes Who Observe Ramadan Fasting
trials.summary: The purpose of this study is to test the efficacy and safety of orforglipron in participants with T2D (type 2 diabetes) who participate in fasting during Ramadan. For each participant, the study will last up to 48 weeks with a minimum of 7 in clinic visits and 4 virtual visits.

trials.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonist Use and Sarcopenia in Obese Individuals Without Diabetes
trials.summary: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs) and dual GLP-1/GIP agonists such as semaglutide and tirzepatide produce marked weight loss in people with obesity, with reported reductions of about 15-20%. Rapid weight loss may reduce not only fat mass but also lean body mass and skeletal muscle mass, raising concern about sarcopenia and sarcopenic obesity. Evidence in non-diabetic obese individuals is limited and inconsistent. This prospective descriptive study will assess muscle mass, mus

archive.title: ADA: Boehringer touts survodutide weight loss as tolerability questions linger
archive.summary: At ADA 2026, Boehringer Ingelheim presented phase 3 SYNCHRONIZE data for its glucagon/GLP-1 dual agonist survodutide, reporting up to 16.6% average weight loss and large visceral-fat reductions. Coverage noted higher treatment-discontinuation rates on the highest doses than for some competing GLP-1 drugs.

archive.title: GLP-1 Drugs 2026: ADA Sessions Close as New Standards End Single-Goal Diabetes Care
archive.summary: A wrap-up of the American Diabetes Association's 2026 Scientific Sessions, where new treatment standards elevated cardiovascular and kidney risk reduction alongside blood-sugar control. The meeting featured phase 3 data for retatrutide, orforglipron and other agents.

archive.title: Ultra-long-acting GLP-1 improves weight loss with and without type 2 diabetes
archive.summary: Data presented at ADA 2026 on berobenatide, an investigational ultra-long-acting GLP-1 receptor agonist studied in the VESPER phase 2b program, reported meaningful weight loss in people with obesity or overweight. Its extended half-life points to potential monthly dosing.

archive.title: Rivus Announces Preclinical Data for RV-8451, a Muscle-Preserving Oral GLP-1, at ADA 2026
archive.summary: Rivus Pharmaceuticals reported preclinical results for RV-8451, an experimental oral GLP-1 receptor agonist, describing fat loss with preservation of lean muscle in non-human primate studies. The company said it plans to file an IND application in early 2027.

archive.title: What RFK Jr.'s Peptide Reclassification Actually Means: A Pharmacist's Take
archive.summary: A pharmacist explains the February 2026 HHS announcement that roughly 14 of 19 FDA-restricted peptides would move from Category 2 to Category 1, restoring a legal compounding pathway with a prescription. The article stresses that reclassification is not FDA approval and does not establish safety or efficacy.

archive.title: Novo Nordisk Advances Cardiometabolic Pipeline with CagriSema and Zenagamtide Data at ADA 2026
archive.summary: Novo Nordisk previewed roughly 40 abstracts for ADA 2026, including new CagriSema data on glycemic control and weight loss and mid-stage results for zenagamtide (amycretin). The release outlined the company's broader cardiometabolic pipeline.

archive.title: Next-Gen Weight-Loss Drug Retatrutide Moves a Step Closer to FDA Approval
archive.summary: Eli Lilly's triple-receptor agonist retatrutide, which targets GLP-1, GIP and glucagon, showed participants losing roughly 28% of body weight over 80 weeks in the phase 3 TRIUMPH-1 trial. The results position it as potentially more potent than current single- and dual-agonist obesity drugs.

archive.title: FDA Proposes Ban on Bulk Compounding of Semaglutide and Tirzepatide
archive.summary: The FDA announced on April 30, 2026 that it is proposing to exclude semaglutide, tirzepatide and liraglutide from the 503B bulks list, citing no current clinical need for outsourcing facilities to compound them from bulk substances. A public comment period was opened ahead of a final decision.

archive.title: FDA Mulls Compounding for Peptides Previously Flagged Over Safety Risks
archive.summary: The FDA scheduled a July 2026 advisory-committee meeting to reconsider whether compounding pharmacies may prepare seven peptides the agency had earlier flagged for safety concerns. The piece notes HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s support for broader peptide access.

archive.title: FDA Considers Adding a Dozen Peptides to Its Bulk Drug Compounding List
archive.summary: The Regulatory Affairs Professionals Society reported that the FDA's Pharmacy Compounding Advisory Committee will evaluate whether about twelve peptides should be added to the Section 503A bulk drug list for licensed compounding. Proposed indications include wound healing, insomnia and ulcerative colitis.

archive.title: FDA Approves Orforglipron, First GLP-1 Pill Without Time, Food, or Water Restrictions
archive.summary: The FDA approved Eli Lilly's orforglipron (Foundayo), an oral GLP-1 receptor agonist, for adults with obesity or overweight, with no food, water or timing restrictions. Trials reported dose-dependent weight loss versus placebo.

archive.title: Tirzepatide Cuts Major Heart and Kidney Risks in New SURPASS-CVOT Data
archive.summary: In the SURPASS-CVOT trial in people with type 2 diabetes and cardiovascular disease, tirzepatide met noninferiority versus dulaglutide on the primary cardiovascular endpoint and showed reductions in a broader cardiorenal composite. Gastrointestinal side effects were more common with tirzepatide.

archive.title: Semaglutide Does Not Slow Alzheimer's Disease, Two Clinical Trials Find
archive.summary: Two phase 3 trials (EVOKE and EVOKE+) of about 3,800 patients with early Alzheimer's found that oral semaglutide produced no significant difference in disease progression versus placebo over two years. Some biomarker changes in a subgroup did not translate into slower cognitive decline.

archive.title: Novo Nordisk Expands Pivotal Amycretin Program After Dual Agonist Shines in Diabetes
archive.summary: Novo Nordisk said it would expand the phase 3 program for amycretin, a single-molecule GLP-1/amylin co-agonist, after phase 2 diabetes data showed substantial HbA1c and body-weight reductions. The move advances amycretin alongside the company's CagriSema program.

archive.title: Semaglutide Receives FDA Approval for Treatment of MASH
archive.summary: The FDA approved semaglutide (Wegovy) 2.4 mg as the first GLP-1 receptor agonist for non-cirrhotic MASH with moderate-to-advanced liver fibrosis, based on the ESSENCE trial. Reported data showed higher rates of MASH resolution versus placebo.

archive.title: FDA Approval for Mitochondrial Therapeutic Elamipretide, Formerly SS-31
archive.summary: The FDA granted accelerated approval to elamipretide (FORZINITY), the mitochondria-targeted peptide previously known as SS-31, for Barth syndrome, a rare mitochondrial disease. The approval was supported by trial data showing improved muscle strength.
